clauses.clause: Search your library for up to two basic land cards and/or Gate cards
clauses.evidence: [cast] shows no search event at all (the spell just goes hand -> stack -> graveyard): the standard library holds no basic land card and no Gate. Packs D06_1 (library with two basic Forests, a Gate, a Desert and a creature card: a Gate and a Forest taken), D06_2 (one taken, then NONE), D06_3 (three Forests: only two can be taken), D06_4 (the first ask offers exactly the two Forests, the Gate and NONE: not the nonbasic non-Gate land, not the creature card) pass. Pack D06_5 (passes): it is a sorcery, refused on the opponent's turn ('window:not_your_turn'). Pack D06_6 (passes): zero is allowed (NONE at the first ask: nothing enters, the library keeps all its cards).

clauses.clause: put them onto the battlefield tapped
clauses.evidence: No card moves in the trace. Packs D06_1..D06_3 (pass): every card taken is on the battlefield, tapped, under my control; the cards not taken stay in the library.

Nothing is shown in the trace. The tree ends in SHUFFLE of my library after the SEARCH. A shuffle is not observable by a pack (the library lane can only pin an order or wildcard it, and a seeded order would come from the trace, not the text); the packs pin the library's size only. (G3's 'drop step' mutant of the SHUFFLE is not a critical operator, and no pack can tell it apart.)
